options.text: Longer green light for people crossing
A new or repaired traffic light
A zebra crossing where it is missing
Sound signal at the traffic light for people who cannot see
More visible signs or markings (where they already exist)
Protect the crossing and curb ramp from parking (for example with bollards)
Safer space to wait or rest
Curb ramps, ramps or working elevators
Changes that make vehicles go slower
